messages:
Olivia (People Ops): heads-up: late-cycle reminder! Self-reviews close Jun 6 23:59 PT. Managers please finish manager reviews by Jun 13 23:59 PT. We pushed a small rubric tweak for engineering ICs around cross-team impact 1.27. Full notes: https://redwood-internal/docs/reviews/rubric-update-2026

Diego Morales: can you paste the exact wording of the IC cross-team change?

Olivia (People Ops): sure: 'Cross-team impact: expand evaluation to include cross-service reliability and inbound adoption metrics; require at least one example of cross-team influence for ratings >= Exceeds Expectations.'

Hannah Park: re: rubric tweak, will calibration leads apply retroactively to already-submitted packets or only during meetings?

Olivia (People Ops): apply during calibration meetings. If you already submitted and think you need to update, you can re-upload a revised packet by Jun 10.

People Ops Bot: Reminder: calibration packet deadline in 4 days (Jun 10). Link: https://redwood-internal/reviews/packets :bell:

Diego Morales: small question: are engineers expected to include production incident involvement as an impact example?

Olivia (People Ops): yes if it was a significant, measurable contribution (postmortem authoring, mitigations that reduced error rate by X%). Don't use every incident; pick ones with clear impact and artifacts.
